title: Dealer API: accept amounts in euros
description: Most dealer management systems export amounts in euros ("1999.90"). DealerOfferRequest now also accepts down_payment_eur and extra_costs_eur and converts them to cents before validation; the cents fields win if both are sent, and the usual cents rules still apply. Tests added.

defects.explanation: Converts euros to cents with float multiplication and an int cast, which truncates: 19.99 becomes 1998 cents and 0.29 becomes 28; amounts must be parsed exactly (or at least rounded), and more than two decimals should be rejected.
